trailhead.label: Varena (the village square), the APT’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Quiet village lanes at the start and end, open to cars, and a few metres on the Lavazè pass road (SS620) in the village: keep your dog close.
Loose small stones on the last stretch, which the APT warns can stop small pram wheels.
Open meadows: in summer stay on the track and keep your dog off the hay.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
